posts.text: Hi all! If you are free and would like to join, I am thinking of doing a personal "for fun" (zero cost, zero prizes) online event for Riftbound using Riftatlas on Monday evening the 16th (11/16/26) at 5:30 PM. It would be a three round "Mini-Worlds" event, with the same rules: Players would play three decks (Deck A, B, and C) in rounds 1, 2, and 3, with a stipulation that they do not play legends that share domains (ie., can't play Ezreal then Mel then Riven, as they all share Chaos domain)…
